audit.whatIsWrong: content spikes[1] and mid told the reader that 'Between Worlds untargetability neutralizes his Event Horizon cage setup'. Between Worlds grants no untargetability — it is a leap, a shockwave, and a slowing zone with a teleport. Worse, the page never stated that Primordial Burst scales with the target's MISSING health, or that Baleful Strike converts minion kills into permanent AP.
audit.why: Riot's text: R 'deals a large amount of magic damage, increasing based on the target's missing health'; Q 'Units killed by this bolt grant Veigar some ability power permanently'; E 'creating a cage that Stuns enemies that pass through' — the perimeter, which means a dash out of the ring stuns you as surely as walking through it.
audit.corrected: spikes[1], whys[4] and content mid replaced with the real rule (stay outside the 725 cage range and hold your health bar high). report[5].t, breakdown.cooldowns, dontsFull[2].d and phases[4].why now carry the missing-health scaling and the dash-through-the-ring stun.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer gave Levels 4-5 and 6 to 'Skill' and the two item stages to Veigar, while content win[0..6] and the packet levelChart both read Aurora on all seven rows — and the full layer's own whys for those rows describe Aurora winning them.
audit.why: phases[N].side and win[N] are the same row. Packet and content agree; the rows that disagreed were also arguing against themselves in their own why text.
audit.corrected: phases[3..6].side set to Aurora and phases[6].rating brought to 6/10 to match the other Aurora rows, with every affected why rewritten in the same proposal around Veigar's real timers.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] and content early credited the poke to 'Q Twin Drift', an ability in neither kit, and described Dark Matter only as 'slow'.
audit.why: Aurora's Q has no such name; the full layer names her W 'Across the Veil'. Veigar's real curve is Baleful Strike falling from 6s to 4s while permanently stacking AP, Dark Matter's cooldown shrinking with Phenomenal Evil stacks, and Primordial Burst at 120s dropping to 60s.
audit.corrected: Both rebuilt around the delayed marked cast of Dark Matter and the permanent AP on Baleful Strike kills; the fabricated name is gone.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all.
audit.why: Event Horizon at 20s rank 1 down to 14s is the single window this lane is played around, and Baleful Strike at 6s down to 4s is what punishes a step-up.
audit.corrected: All three cooldowns now stated alongside the ring rule.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeGood/tradeBad were generic and were pasted verbatim into dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d under unrelated titles.
audit.why: The concrete trading fact is that Veigar has zero mobility, so a trade that ends with you walking away is free — but a trade that ends with you dashing is not, because the ring stuns anything crossing it.
audit.corrected: Both trade strings and both bled bullets rewritten to their own titles.

notes: Confidence on the level-chart alignment is Medium, not High: packet levelChart and content win[] both say Aurora on all seven rows, and the full layer's own whys for the two Veigar-side rows described Aurora winning, so the rows were self-contradictory and had to be resolved one way. I resolved them toward the two agreeing sources. But a fully stacked Veigar at two-plus items is a genuine threat and a case could be made that the '2+ items' row should belong to him; if the user wants that row given to Veigar instead, the why and the content win[6] must move with it. Flagged rather than left half-fixed. Also: Veigar's W is listed with cd 0 in the kit because Phenomenal Evil stacks reduce it, so I described Dark Matter by its delayed marked cast rather than quoting a cooldown. wants.you[1] previously credited Aurora's E with slowing his 'passive stacks'; his AP comes from Baleful Strike kills and from hitting champions with spells, so the corrected line targets the minion kills, which is the part a laner can actually deny.
